raw.details:
BUILDFEST 2026 is a National-Level Student Hackathon by Learnix Labs, giving students across India a platform to showcase their technology projects, gain recognition, and connect with fellow innovators.

Only projects developed during the official hackathon period are eligible.

Partners & Supporters

BUILDFEST 2026 is supported by our valued partners who help us empower student innovation and expand opportunities for the developer community.

  • Eventopia – Official Media Partner
  • .xyz – Domain Partner

Project Domains

  • Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning
  • Web & App Development
  • Cybersecurity
  • Data Science & Analytics
  • Blockchain & Emerging Technologies
  • Open Source & Social Impact
  • Other innovative technology projects

Problem Statements

BUILDFEST 2026 does not provide predefined problem statements. Participants can choose any problem or idea and develop an original technology-based project within the listed domains. Innovative solutions addressing real-world challenges are encouraged.

Participation Process

  1. Register: Sign up through Unstop.
  2. Publish: Publish your project at https://learnixlabs.in/project.
  3. Prepare: Write a brief abstract covering the problem, solution, technologies, and key features.
  4. Submit: Upload your project URL and abstract on Unstop.
  5. Share: Promote your project and receive valid community upvotes.

Community Choice Award

Awarded to the eligible project receiving the highest number of valid community upvotes.

Rules & Guidelines

  • Projects must be developed during the official hackathon period and published within the official submission period.
  • Both project URL and abstract must be submitted on Unstop.
  • Projects must remain publicly accessible.
  • Plagiarism, copied work, and misleading information are prohibited.
  • Artificial engagement and vote manipulation are strictly prohibited.
  • Incomplete or late submissions will not be considered.
  • Judges' and organizers' decisions are final.

Certificates and recognition will be provided as announced by the organizers.

prizes.others: National Winner Certificate, featured on Learnix Labs official social media platforms, and priority consideration for future Learnix Labs opportunities.
Excellence Certificate and featured on Learnix Labs official social media platforms.
Merit Certificate and mention on Learnix Labs official social media platforms.
Top Performer Certificate, a free .xyz domain for the first year (worth $15), Top Performer Badge, and recognition on Learnix Labs official social media platforms.
